        🛠 Design Patterns & Architecture (Inferact/vLLM)

        
          🔄 LLM Inference Patterns
          
            PagedAttention Pattern Current Core to vLLMVirtual memory management for KV-cache, enabling memory-efficient serving of thousands of concurrent requests by eliminating fragmentation.
            Continuous Batching Pattern CurrentDynamic request scheduling that adds/removes requests mid-generation, maximizing GPU utilization vs static batching.
            Speculative Decoding Pattern Current High PerformanceDraft model generates tokens fast, target model verifies in parallel, achieving 2-3x speedup with lossless quality.
            Prefix Caching Pattern CurrentReuse KV-cache for common prefixes (system prompts, RAG contexts) across requests, reducing redundant computation.
            Mixture of Experts (MoE) Routing Current ComplexConditional computation: only subset of parameters activated per token, enabling larger models with same compute budget.
          
        

        
          🛠 GPU/Hardware Patterns
          
            Tensor Parallelism Pattern CurrentSplit individual layers across multiple GPUs for single-request throughput, ideal for large models (70B+) that exceed single GPU memory.
            Pipeline Parallelism Pattern CurrentSplit model layers across GPUs in pipeline stages, enabling inference of very large models with micro-batching.
            Weight Quantization Pattern Current AWQ/GPTQ/GGUFReduce model precision (FP16 -> INT8/INT4) trading minor quality loss for 2-4x memory reduction and speedup.
            KV-Cache Compression CurrentReduce memory footprint of attention caches via quantization, sparse attention, or window-based eviction strategies.
            FlashAttention Pattern Current IO-AwareIO-aware exact attention algorithm that reduces memory reads/writes, achieving 2-4x speedup on standard attention.

            Disaggregated Serving Pattern Future EmergingSeparate prefill and decode phases onto different hardware, optimizing each phase independently for maximum efficiency.
            Hardware-Software Co-Design FutureCustom CUDA kernels co-designed with next-gen GPU architectures (Blackwell, Rubin) for maximum hardware utilization.
            Adaptive Precision Inference FutureDynamic per-layer precision switching (FP4/FP8/INT4) based on layer sensitivity, achieving optimal quality-speed tradeoff.
